dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin (viewer perspective) relative to the smoother right margin in the anterior-mid section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey median pixel intensity consistent with a sub-adult or light juvenile phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, longitudinal darker grey streaks primarily oriented along the mid-dorsal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the baseline grey canvas and the darker longitudinal streaks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple small, high-contrast white circular marks (possible water droplets or point lesions) and one distinct dark longitudinal mark in the anterior dorsal region.
